assumption: Native directory-open layouts, statuses and capture order are bounded to Windows10.0.29683.1000.
basis: 45 source/PE/stdout-verified native producers, two complete fresh ARM64 captures, 69684 syscall/duplication case rows, and the installed wow64/ntdll binary identities.
dependent-result: Directory service mechanics and ABI adaptation.
stress-test: Invalid lengths, roots, aliases, name encodings and simultaneous protected input/output buffers.
falsification-probe: A different installed build or completed guard matrix differs.
status: confirmed on measured Windows10.0.29683.1000; additional builds/native physical x64 unknown

assumption: Immutable selected namespace metadata can represent read-only installed-runtime directory lookup without retaining host handles.
basis: Four profiles capture identical151-entry names/types/order across the root, KnownDlls and KnownDlls32; runtime acquisition uses bounded repeated enumeration, captured grants and no retained native handles.
dependent-result: Namespace snapshot and Directory guest resource design.
stress-test: Changed host entries, symbolic links, case variants, missing children and typed mismatches.
falsification-probe: A reached directory lookup depends on state absent from the snapshot.
status: confirmed by native Windows snapshot and installed ARM64/x86 leaf test; later uncaptured namespace state remains explicitly unsupported

assumption: The default native guest keeps the selected host principal and captured authorization context.
basis: Actual native probe principal is NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM, SID S-1-5-18. No supported token/impersonation service exists in current source; directory grants are selected per host principal.
dependent-result: Captured maximum-access policy for selected directories.
stress-test: An isolated impersonation-token privilege enable/restore cycle, DACL versus privilege error priority, and supported guest impersonation after selection.
falsification-probe: A supported reachable service changes the effective principal or DACL policy.
status: retained; captured maximum and ACCESS_SYSTEM_SECURITY status implemented; 288 isolated-token native rows replayed on all three hosts and installed Windows adapter/leaf passed

assumption: Fresh x64/WoW64 directory initialization follows the observed same-kernel mature contract.
basis: All mature profiles agree on lookup and access; fresh debugger capture is ARM64 only.
stress-test: Fresh original compatibility entry and true-return capture.

assumption: Forced case-insensitive NT directory lookup is a property of the selected host namespace, rather than only the guest OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE bit.
basis: All four native format profiles accept the lowercase KnownDlls path with flags0; runtime acquisition compares original, inverted-case and explicit-fold probes.
stress-test: Case-sensitive host policy, folded collisions and captured typed children.
falsification-probe: Actual acquisition probes disagree or a reached mixed-case lookup differs from the host.
status: confirmed on measured host; other host configurations selected dynamically

assumption: Measured WoW64 redirection and prefix-read mechanics are bounded to the installed Windows10.0.29683.1000 profile.
basis: Four6656-case name-extent profiles; 16-byte case-sensitive and per-WCHAR case-insensitive first-mismatch read extents. The raw installed image was inspected; complete loaded ARM64X fixup/target equivalence is not established.
dependent-result: WoW64 directory attribute conversion, system-root prefix probes and caller-output copy ordering.
stress-test: NULL output, first/later guard page, 13 byte-prefix extents, count0/odd/65532, pseudo root and flags0/40.
falsification-probe: Native loaded thunk under another build/host or a matching system-path prefix produces a different result; matching redirection paths currently return explicit unsupported.
status: confirmed for observed negative-prefix cases on measured host; other loaded profiles and matching-system-path redirection remain unknown
